lines.trans: What a magnificent theater! Learning under a legendary dancer, you will all surely shine.
All right, let's move—time to hand out flyers on the street!
Four hours left until curtain. There's no time to stand around resting.
Wait—we're doing full-scale dancing like that?
If you're not serious about it, want to quit right now?

words.gram: Compound noun meaning willingness or motivation to act.

lines.trans: Come on, doing choreography like that right off the bat is impossible.
This stage is no place for half-baked amateurs to stand!
I fell in love with dance and have met the audience's gaze head-on with this body.
With nothing but our bodies, we get men excited all across the world!
Then go ahead and show me those bodies you're so proud of.
Fine by me—watch me do it!
Customers pay good money to watch! You can't dance onstage like that—one more time!
